subject: Post-demo: Encryption, BYOK options & security questionnaire
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: Monterey Sales <sales@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Encryption, BYOK options & security questionnaire

Hi Maria — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and clear next steps from our side so your security team can evaluate: 

1) Demo highlights
- Hosted + dedicated deployment options.
- Prefix/KV caching preserves performance with CMK-attached instances.
- Support for HSM-backed key stores via cloud KMS integrations or customer HSM (BYOK).

2) Security artifacts you asked for
- SOC 2 Type II report (summary attached).
- High-level KMS/BYOK design options (attached pdf).

3) Questions for your team (please confirm):
- Which regulatory scope is primary for this project? HIPAA only, HIPAA+GDPR, or GDPR-first?
- Do you require HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2/3) for at-rest envelope keys, or is cloud KMS with customer-managed CMKs acceptable?
- Are you expecting Customer-Managed Keys (BYOK) held in your cloud account, or an HSM appliance inside your VPC/on-prem?
- Timeline: when does procurement want vendor questionnaires returned (target date)?

4) Proposed next steps
- I can initiate the vendor security questionnaire and route it to the technical contact you nominate.
- If you want an architecture deep-dive, propose a 60-minute technical session with Rachel (security compliance) and Monica (solutions engineering) — they can bring BYOK implementation options and sample answers.

Please reply with the technical contact and any hard deadlines you have for the questionnaire. If it helps, I can pre-fill obvious fields and mark items we need your input on.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_kms_options_overview.pdf, soc2-report-summary.pdf
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acuityhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acuity Security Team <security@acuityhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 09:20:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Encryption, BYOK options & security questionnaire

Thanks Sean — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick answers and requests so we can move this through procurement/security: 

- Regulatory scope: HIPAA + we need a GDPR DPA for any EEA data.
- We would prefer HSM-backed keys for primary key material (FIPS requirement for patient data), but cloud HSM (e.g., AWS CloudHSM or Azure Dedicated HSM) is acceptable if the HSM is dedicated and customer-controlled.
- BYOK preference: customer-managed CMKs in our cloud tenant backed by HSM (not vendor-owned keys).
- Procurement timeline: vendor questionnaire needs to be returned by 2027-08-12; SOC 2 must be the latest Type II report.

I've attached our vendor questionnaire template — please fill what you can and highlight the fields that require follow-up. Also include an initial runbook/operational ownership matrix for key rotation and incident response.

Technical contact: Miguel Santos (miguel.santos@acuityhealth.com) — please include him on the technical deep-dive.

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acuityhealth.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 13:45:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Encryption, BYOK options & security questionnaire

Hi Maria / Miguel — great, thanks for the clarifications. Attached are: 
- A one-page SOC 2 summary (we will provide the full Type II under NDA/procurement channels).
- KMS/BYOK options doc with recommended patterns for HIPAA workloads.
- A pre-filled copy of your vendor questionnaire with suggested answers in bold; I left items needing legal or network-level detail blank and highlighted them.

A few clarifying points from our side so your security team can review quickly: 
- For HSM-backed CMKs we support two common approaches: 1) Customer-managed CMKs in their cloud KMS (recommended) where Redwood is given an IAM role to use the key for envelope encryption, or 2) Dedicated hardware HSM in the customer VPC with a gateway we can connect to (more complex, longer lead time).
- Key rotation model: envelope keys rotated by Redwood every 90 days by default; master/key-encryption-keys rotate per customer policy when using BYOK and can be rotated by customer-initiated re-keys.
- Audit/logging: we can ship audit events to your SIEM; we also provide per-request token-level logging (configurable retention).

Next steps I propose:
- Rachel & Monica to run a 60-minute technical deep-dive with Miguel + one of your security leads. Suggested slots: Tue 2027-08-03 10:00 or Wed 2027-08-04 14:00 PT. Please confirm.
- Procurement deadline: we'll prioritize the questionnaire and return a completed draft by 2027-08-09 to give you a couple of days to review before the 8/12 target.

Link to HubSpot deal where I'll attach the updated questionnaire: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/AC-2027-0910

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachments: vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx, soc2-report-summary.pdf, redwood_kms_options_overview.pdf

Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: Encryption, BYOK options & security questionnaire — action items

Hi Rachel / Monica — forwarding the thread with Acuity Health. They want the vendor questionnaire back by 2027-08-12 and prefer HSM-backed, customer-managed CMKs in their cloud tenant. Miguel Santos is the technical contact.

Please own these items: 
- Rachel: can you review the highlighted legal/compliance fields (DPA/GDPR/HIPAA attestation text) and provide the legal-approved language for the questionnaire? Target: 2027-08-05 for draft answers so I can incorporate.
- Monica: please schedule a 60-minute deep-dive with Miguel and one Acuity security lead. Suggested slots I proposed: 2027-08-03 10:00 PT or 2027-08-04 14:00 PT — if neither works propose other times. Also confirm the engineering answers in the questionnaire (key rotation, KMS connectivity, HSM gateway options).
- Attachments in HubSpot: I'll upload the pre-filled questionnaire and SOC 2 summary — use deal AC-2027-0910 for traceability.

Suggested pre-fill guidance for the questionnaire (short answers you can copy):
- Q: Who holds the encryption keys? A: Customers can hold CMKs in their cloud KMS (BYOK). Redwood supports envelope encryption and never retains plaintext master keys.
- Q: Is HSM used for key material? A: Yes — we support customer-managed HSM-backed CMKs (CloudHSM / Azure Dedicated HSM); Redux can also integrate with on-prem HSM via a secure gateway if required.
- Q: Auditability? A: Per-request metadata and KMS operation logs are available and can be forwarded to the customer's SIEM; retention configurable.

Let me know if you need any additional artifacts; procurement is expecting the completed questionnaire in 7–10 business days.

Thanks,
Sean
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
